description.value: Airborne creatures take a -1 penalty on attack and damage rolls against an air elemental.

effect: Airborne creatures take a -1 penalty on attack and damage rolls against an air elemental.

description.value: Once every 1d3 rounds, an air elemental can use its wings to cause a breath-like attack to slice the air in front of it in a 30-ft.- cone. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of wind damage, Reflex save (DC 21) for half damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 23).
